name: ReadOut (local TTS)
head: Streaming playback passed real-audio QA on one M-series Mac (0 underruns, 0.29 s to audio vs 27 s batch); SP-1 default decision awaits Dave
statusReason: Streaming playback (assessment item 1) is implemented behind streaming_playback (default off) and on 2026-10-26 passed docs/QA.md 2b on a MacBook Air: /speak returned in 0.29 s vs 27.29 s batch for 3,589 chars, 50 chunks played with 0 underruns, stop in 113 ms, save intact. No human listened; counters and the WAV are the evidence. Windows and Intel CPUs are unmeasured, so the default stays off until Dave answers SP-1.

evidence.note: Local pytest pass on Python 3.12 (unit + e2e; PowerShell tool tests skipped on macOS). GitHub Actions tests and package-smoke runs were in progress at record time.

streamingPlayback.scope: Kokoro chunks play through a sounddevice OutputStream as the generator produces them; sentence-aware split in streaming mode; stop and cloud playback abort the live stream; save waits for synthesis so saved_to stays in the response.
streamingPlayback.verification: Local pytest green; GitHub tests workflow green. Real-audio run 2026-10-26 via scripts/qa_streaming.py on an M-series MacBook Air: 0.29 s to audio start (batch 27.29 s), 50/50 chunks, 0 underruns, stop 113 ms, 15.1 s WAV saved. Not listened to by a human.
streamingPlayback.notDone: No pause/resume/seek, no server-sent events, no job queue, no cloud-engine streaming, no loudness normalisation.
streamingPlayback.nextAction: Dave answers SP-1 (recommended B: default on for macOS); measure once on Windows (Duncan) before C.

nextStep.title: Answer SP-1 and, if B, flip the macOS default
nextStep.why: The Mac measurement shows no underruns and a 94x faster audio start, but Windows is unmeasured and the decision is Dave's.
nextStep.doneWhen: SP-1 recorded in DECISION_LOG.md with a date; if B or C, config default changed with a test and README note; if C, a Windows run of scripts/qa_streaming.py recorded.

findings.title: Streaming playback implemented and proven on one Mac; default still off
findings.detail: StreamPlayer in tts_engine.py; 15 unit tests; real-audio 2b pass 2026-10-26 (0 underruns, 0.29 s vs 27.29 s). scripts/qa_streaming.py reproduces it.

findings.title: ElevenLabs voice names are sent as voice ids
findings.detail: engines/elevenlabs.py passes catalogue names such as Rachel into the /v1/text-to-speech/{id} URL; only the hardcoded default id works. Fix is part of assessment item 19.

findings.title: Accelerator never selected for Kokoro
findings.detail: KPipeline is built without a device argument, so Apple Silicon runs on CPU despite PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK in main.py. Assessment item 10.

findings.title: 24 further assessment items proposed
findings.detail: Pause/resume, SSE, job queue, word timestamps/captions, compressed export, loudness, device selection, ONNX, cache, languages, blending, lexicon, preprocessing, hotkeys, extension a11y, shared-secret auth, cloud streaming, model distribution, telemetry, audio regression harness, pyproject/lint, signing/updates, document ingestion.

phases.name: Phase 1: streaming playback (item 1)
phases.goal: Audio starts after the first sentence, behind a flag
phases.gate: docs/QA.md 2b passes on real hardware; SP-1 answered

phases.name: Phase 2: compounding items (2 to 25)
phases.goal: Build the next assessment item after a scoped brief
phases.gate: Each item has a brief, tests and a QA section before its flag flips

decisionsForDave: SP-1 [Open, 2026-10-26]: streaming playback default. Measured on one M-series Mac: 0 underruns, 0.29 s to audio. A keep off; B on for macOS only (recommended after measurement); C on everywhere (needs a Windows run). Unlocks the default flip.

SP-2 [Open, 2026-10-26]: save semantics while streaming. A wait for synthesis so saved_to stays in the /speak response (implemented, recommended); B return at once and expose the path via /status. Unlocks whether /control needs a second poll.

RO-NEXT [Open, 2026-10-26]: next assessment item. A item 2 pause/resume/position (recommended; builds on 1, unlocks 3 and 5); B item 19 cloud streaming and the ElevenLabs voice-id fix; C item 18 shared-secret auth. Unlocks the next brief.
verify: python scripts/qa_streaming.py against a running daemon
context: Local-first desktop TTS (Kokoro on-device, OpenAI and ElevenLabs optional). FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:7778, Chrome extension, /control browser panel as the macOS UI.
kickoffPrompt: Record Dave's SP-1 answer in DECISION_LOG.md; if B, set streaming_playback default true on macOS in config.py with a test and README note, run python -m pytest, commit and push.
